{{Infobox faction|name=House Ashbourne|philosophy=Courage|sigil=A leaping stag in midair over an abyss, all hooves off the ground; gold on deep red|words=We land where we dare.|seat=[[Dawnwatch]]|region=[[the Edgelands]]|head=[[Roderick Ashbourne]]|heir=[[Kael Ashbourne]]|figures=[[Isolde Ashbourne]], [[Bran the Unfallen]]}}
'''House Ashbourne''' is the house of '''courage''': hesitation is the only true loss. Strike first, hardest, without waiting for the perfect moment — an enemy forced to react has already lost. Power is momentum, and courage is contagious.

== Philosophy and reputation ==
''"He who asks 'should I?' has already answered no."'' A bold defeat outranks a cautious victory. Ashbourne is the realm's shock cavalry — called upon when something must be taken, forgotten in peace — irresistible on the offensive and, its rivals note, mortal in the long defensive.

== Customs ==
* '''The Leap''' — the annual trial of courage: a ride, a climb, a duel, a journey beyond the mountains. To refuse is dishonor; to die is honorable. The leader must have their own Leap behind them. ''See [[The Leap]].''
* '''The Wall of Names''' — every Ashbourne who has died in a Leap or border skirmish is carved into the wall at Dawnwatch, by their own next of kin. It grows constantly; the house calls it its most beautiful and darkest place at once.

== The seat ==
[[Dawnwatch]] is a forward fortress facing the mountains and the unknown east — built for sallying forth, not for siege: broad gates, everything designed to get riders out fast. From its towers, some nights, there is light or smoke beyond the mountains that no one can explain. Many have gone to look. Not all have returned.

== Members (396 A.U.) ==
* '''[[Roderick Ashbourne]]''' (~52), head of house — once the realm's most feared rider; twelve Leaps behind him.
* '''[[Kael Ashbourne]]''' (~26), heir — everything his father once was.
* '''[[Isolde Ashbourne]]''' (~30), daughter — sharper than her brother, and passed over.
* '''[[Bran the Unfallen]]''' (~60), weapon-master — has survived more Leaps than anyone living; the nickname is tribute and mockery at once.
